title: Tekken 3, remade
intro: A remake of the PlayStation Tekken 3 in Godot 4.7, with every mode, character and unlock, checked frame by frame against the original.

chapters.title: Your disc, converted
chapters.body: The remake's converter reads your own disc image (Japan Rev 1, original Japan or USA), then Godot imports the result once. Python, Godot and FFmpeg are fetched first if your PC does not have them.

chapters.title: Modern look
chapters.body: Modern graphics, texture packs and controller support on top of the original's timing.

chapters.title: Arcade extras
chapters.body: Your Tekken 3 arcade set optionally adds the arcade's stages, fighter models and fight music.
